privacyPage.s2Intro: We collect the following types of data when you shop or create an account:

privacyPage.s2li2: Delivery address: street, postal code, city and country
privacyPage.s2li3: Payment information: handled securely by Stripe (we do not store card numbers)
privacyPage.s2li4: Order history: products, prices and delivery status
privacyPage.s3li2: Communicate with you about delivery and support
privacyPage.s4p1: Processing is based on contract performance (for orders) and our legitimate interest in running the online store and providing customer service.
privacyPage.s5p1: We keep your data as long as needed to complete orders and meet accounting law (7 years). Payment data is handled by Stripe under their privacy policy.

privacyPage.s5li4: Competent authorities where required by law

termsPage.title: Terms of sale
termsPage.introBefore: Please read Turbomeck’s terms of sale. For questions, contact us at
termsPage.s1p1: These terms apply to all purchases from Turbomeck. By placing an order you accept these terms. The agreement takes effect when we confirm your order.
termsPage.s2p1: All prices are in Swedish kronor (SEK) including VAT unless otherwise stated. Payment is via Stripe (card, Klarna, etc.). You are charged when the order is approved.
termsPage.s3Title: 3. Core return (old turbo) – customers with delivery address in Sweden
termsPage.s3p1: For orders where the delivery address is in Sweden, the following applies to your old turbo (core). At checkout you choose whether you commit to sending in the core within 14 days, or pay a fixed core fee of 1,000 SEK with the purchase (you then keep your old turbo).
termsPage.s3li1: If you choose to send in your old turbo within 14 days as instructed, no core fee is charged at checkout. If you still fail to send in the core within 14 days, we are entitled to charge you 1,000 SEK (e.g. by invoice).
termsPage.s3li2: If you choose not to send in the core, you pay 1,000 SEK as a core fee at checkout, in addition to other prices, shipping and any discount.
termsPage.s3li3: The part you return must be correct and usable as a core as described for the product. If the return is incorrect or incomplete, we may reject the core return and handle the matter by agreement and applicable law.
termsPage.s4p1: We ship orders via PostNord. Delivery usually takes 2–5 business days within the Nordics; longer for international deliveries. You receive tracking information when the shipment is on its way.
termsPage.s4p2: For home delivery or pickup at a service point, you must be available or collect the parcel within the specified time. Otherwise return shipping costs may be charged to you.
termsPage.s5p1: As a consumer you have 14 days’ right of withdrawal from the day you received the goods. Contact us at shop@turbomeck.se within that time. Goods must be returned in new condition with original packaging.
termsPage.s5p2: If you withdraw from the order, we refund payment within 14 days after we receive the returned goods. Return shipping is paid by the customer unless otherwise applies for defective goods.
termsPage.s6p1: Products are covered by a two-year right to make a complaint under Swedish consumer sale law. If there is a fault or defect, contact us and we will remedy it in accordance with the law. We may investigate the fault before providing compensation or replacement.
termsPage.s7p1: Turbomeck is not liable for delays or failed deliveries caused by circumstances beyond our control (e.g. natural disasters, strikes, pandemics, transport disruptions).
termsPage.s8p1: Swedish law applies to these terms. Disputes should first be resolved through negotiation. As a consumer you may also turn to the Swedish National Board for Consumer Disputes (ARN).
